AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Small Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Small Domestic Animals.

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food.

6. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Crop Products? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Crop Products.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Crop Products.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Crop Products.

9. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundry: Stain Removal? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Laundry: Stain Removal.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundry: Stain Removal.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundry: Stain Removal.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundry: Stain Removal.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Preserving Crop Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking Food and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

4. B — 100 °C

5. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food.

6. B — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

7. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.

8. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products.

9. B — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

10. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundry: Stain Removal.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Cooking Food; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
